Привет! Я постараюсь объяснить тебе вкра.en: Hello, I will try to explain to you briefly how everything works. Grand is a server with a RolePlay mode of play. This means that here everything is like in real life. You start the game as a simple newcomer with no money in your pocket. And its up to you to decide what to become. A cop, a doctor, a bandit. Or just a very rich man who enjoys life

Чтобы не жить на улице тебе будет нужен.en: To avoid living on the street you will need a house, you can do this in a real estate agency or buy from other players. There are houses for every purse, from a dilapidated house in a dangerous neighborhood to luxury housing on Mount VineWood. Of course, running all over the city or taking the bus is not very convenient, so it is better to buy a personal car in one of the car dealerships. Car dealerships, like homes, are different for everyone. If you have a lot of money, the doors of a premium car dealership are open in front of you, if you have no money... Alas, you will have to settle for transport of the budget segment

Хочешь стать успешным человеком? Тогда т.en: Do you want to become a successful person? Then you need your own business, you can buy your own store at a gas station or you can own an entire gun store. There are all kinds of businesses, but the one thing they all have in common is that you have to keep an eye on them to make sure theyre profitable and not a burden

Думаю ты уже понял, что на дом, машину и.en: I think youve already figured out that you need money to buy a house, a car or a business. The salaries at the jobs are different, from the beginning you have access to jobs that are not particularly profitable, but as you play you will gain access to more prestigious and well-paying jobs. You can see the list of jobs by opening the menu with the M key and selecting My job

Ну а если амбиции не дают покоя и хочетс.en: If your ambition is too much to bear and you want to develop in a big and friendly team, one of the organizations is the right one for you.
